_about: W1AW's Morse code frequencies. W1AW is the ARRL's headquarters station; it sends code practice and CW bulletins on these frequencies on the ARRL's published schedule, the same all year in US Central time. A schedule's frequencies, not a band plan, and not a statement that anything is being sent now.
source: https://www.arrl.org/w1aw-operating-schedule and the ARRL bulletin archive, as given in work instruction 494, 2026-09-29
speeds: code practice at 5 to 15 words a minute (slow) or 10 to 35 (fast); CW bulletins at 18
scheduleSource: https://www.arrl.org/w1aw-operating-schedule, the Morse rows only, in US Central time the same all year, as given in work instruction 497, 2026-09-29. The ARRL leaves out legal holidays, which this file does not list.
